body:
WHAT
A normal (root, user-driven) turn has no maximum number of tool rounds and no per-turn output-token budget. Signal-driven recovery nudges — output cut off (bounded only by the consecutive-cutoff streak), Stop hook, open tasks — are not limited by a numeric cap; the failed-batch and wrap-up nudges share the MAX_AUTO_NUDGES budget. The stall detector is the brake that stops a loop that produces nothing new.

WHY
A numeric cap ends long legitimate work mid-task with a silent stop; the stance is that the turn runs until the query is handled, the model stalls, or the user interrupts.

WHERE
engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts — Session.runTurn(): `const capped = this.opts.child ?? false` guards both cap checks and the final-round warning; MAX_AUTO_NUDGES (3), MAX_CUTOFF_STREAK (3); the LENGTH_CONTINUATION_TEXT / RECOVERY_NUDGE_TEXT / INCOMPLETE_TASKS_NUDGE / WRAPUP_NUDGE_TEXT rungs; stall detector block (identicalRounds, pivotCount, STALL_PIVOT_TEXT, STALL_ASK_TEXT). Session.spawnAgent() also lifts caps for children via childSettings.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. A root Session with settings.maxIterationsPerTurn:2 and maxTokensPerTurn:1, fed a FakeProvider with 10 distinct tool-call turns then an end_turn, makes all 11 requests and emits no 'Iteration cap' or 'Turn token budget' command_output.
2. No 'Final tool round' reminder ever appears in any user message of a root turn regardless of maxIterationsPerTurn.
3. A FakeProvider that returns stopReason 'max_tokens' with text three times then end_turn is resumed three times (LENGTH_CONTINUATION_TEXT pushed) and the turn ends normally; a fourth consecutive cutoff ends the turn with the '⏸ the response was cut off' message.
4. The wrap-up nudge fires at most MAX_AUTO_NUDGES times in one turn even if the model keeps answering with a short reply after 5+ tool calls.
5. A subagent spawned via spawnAgent inherits Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER caps: its 6 scripted tool rounds all run when the parent's settings had maxIterationsPerTurn:2.
